prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Héctor, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Héctor thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will start slapping heavy fines on everyone who leaves their bins out. They are finally taking aggressive action to clear our sidewalks for good!"
text: I’ll believe this when I see it, but apparently Mrs. Gable on 4th Street says the council is issuing $200 fines starting Monday. It’s about time they actually did something to clear the sidewalks.
